status.summary: Top-five UFC bantamweight on a two-fight streak: a rear-naked choke of Vinicius Oliveira in a Fight Night headliner (Feb 7, 2026) and a 29-28 x3 decision over Cory Sandhagen at UFC 329 (Jul 11, 2026), avenging his 2019 UFC debut loss. His only loss since March 2021 is a 30-27 x3 decision to Umar Nurmagomedov at UFC 321 (Oct 25, 2025). UFC record 12-3 per ufcstats. His next booking was not verified in this pass.

style.summary: A high-output switch-stance all-rounder who pairs accurate volume boxing and heavy body work with chain takedowns and an opportunistic submission game (back takes, rear-naked chokes, leg locks). Elite wrestlers have controlled him, but his scrambles and late-round takedowns beat Sandhagen.

moves.notes: Weights are relative within each target group, as src/director.js uses them: head moves sum to 1, body to 1, legs to 1. spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for occasional specials. fighters.json time-decayed attempt split is 74.9% head, 17.3% body and 7.8% leg (landed 60.1/27.0/12.9). Body share is above the 14.1% bantamweight average and leg share below 9.7%, so the engine should send more of his volume to the body than for an average 135er. No source in this pass broke down which punches or kicks he uses, so the within-group splits are a generic boxer split. Body hooks and straights lead because his body volume comes in punching exchanges (e.g. 58/66 body vs Patchy Mix with 0 takedowns attempted). Calf and inside are split evenly because nothing sourced favours one. knee 0.05 reflects the flying-knee KO of Miles Johns (ufcstats). No spinning attacks or elbows are documented. Confidence on these splits is low.

engine_notes.note: Takedowns: 3.15 per 15 min time-decayed (2.49 career) at 38% accuracy, vs a 1.60 bantamweight average. Submission attempts: 1.28 per 15 min decayed vs 0.41 league. Control: 14.0 s/min.
Accurate volume: 52% sig accuracy time-decayed (league 45.6%) at 10.5 attempts per minute, with 5.49 landed per minute.
Late surge in his biggest win: in round 3 vs Sandhagen he landed 40 of 54 sig strikes, scored a knockdown and went 7 of 11 on takedowns. He also scored a round-2 knockdown in the Umar loss.
Takedown attempts do not always land against strong defenders: 0 of 10 vs Jose Aldo, though he still logged 7:15 of (mostly clinch) control and won a split decision.
